trial.interpretation: The prelocked absolute selective meta-decision rule abstained from every untouched development candidate. It successfully avoided a negative broad baseline but proved no positive executable selection edge because it produced zero selected trades.

contaminationBoundary.fitWindow: 2025-07-01 to 2025-10-01 is contaminated by model fitting.
contaminationBoundary.developmentWindow: 2025-10-01 to 2026-01-01 is contaminated by IFE1 development evaluation.
contaminationBoundary.futureUse: IFE1 outcomes may be used only for diagnosis and to motivate a causally distinct next-program hypothesis. The same IFE1 feature/model/threshold combination may not be rescued or retuned.

metricImplementationNote: The immutable closeout reports pWinScoreAuc as NaN when zero trades are selected because the early zero-selection metrics branch did not compute AUC. This cannot alter the rejection because zero selection independently fails coverage, selected-trade, breadth, recall, expectancy and bootstrap-net gates. A diagnostic may compute AUC without reopening or replacing the immutable result.
nextAuthorizedResearch: Run diagnosis only on contaminated IFE1 predictions. Any continuation must be a new program with a different prelocked learning objective and untouched 2026 evidence; no R15 mutation.
